Description

Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts puts on a wide range of free and pay-what-you-wish programming this fall and winter under its “Lincoln Center Presents” umbrella. Among the highlights are a campus-wide celebration of Wynton Marsalis, the first winter edition of the Lincoln Center Contemporary Dance Festival and the return of The Legacies of San Juan Hill Festival. In addition, the David Rubenstein Atrium will hold multiple series and family-friendly programs.
